# package server

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103/server"
```

Package server is the protection equipment of IEC 60870-5-103: the secondary station of unbalanced transmission (clause 6.2.3). It answers the link procedures of the controlling system, hands control-direction ASDUs to a [Handler](#type-handler), transmits monitor-direction ASDUs as class 1 data (events, answers) or class 2 data (measurands) when polled, and runs the system functions itself:

  - identification after reset CU and reset FCB, and once after start (clause 7.4.1, table 8);
  - time synchronization (clause 7.4.2): the server keeps the clock offset, answers with ASDU 6 and flags its time tags invalid until the first synchronization and when none came for [Config.SyncTimeout](#func-config-synctimeout). A synchronization whose time is flagged invalid, or lies outside the years 1970 to 2069 that CP56Time2a carries, is not applied: the clock stays as it was, and an addressed one is answered with ASDU 6 carrying the station's time with IV set;
  - the disturbance data transfer of clause 7.4.7 from a [DisturbanceSource](#type-disturbancesource), when one is configured; the selection of a record whose number of channels (NOC) or of values per channel (NOE) does not fit its field is answered with TOO 34.

The application answers general interrogations, general commands and generic services through the helpers [Server.AnswerGI](#func-server-answergi), [Server.AckCommand](#func-server-ackcommand), [Server.GenericAnswer](#func-server-genericanswer) and [Server.GenericIdentAnswer](#func-server-genericidentanswer).

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// Link holds the link options. The address field is always one octet
	// (clause 6.2.3); Link.FT12 is set accordingly.
	Link link.Config
	// LinkAddr is this station's link address, 0..254.
	LinkAddr uint8
	// CommonAddr is the common address of ASDU. Zero means LinkAddr
	// (clause 7.2.4).
	CommonAddr uint8
	// Fun is the main function type of the equipment, which the
	// identification messages and the list of recorded disturbances carry
	// (table 8, note 2; clause 7.3.1.11). It is required: zero is refused
	// with [iec103.ErrInvalidConfig].
	Fun iec103.FunctionType
	// Identification is the body of the identification (ASDU 5).
	Identification iec103.Identification
	// StartCause is the cause of the identification sent once after start:
	// [iec103.CausePowerOn] (the default) or [iec103.CauseStartRestart]
	// for equipment that cannot tell power on from restart (clause 7.4.1).
	StartCause iec103.Cause

	// Handler handles control-direction ASDUs. Nil answers general
	// interrogations with an empty cycle and general commands negatively.
	Handler Handler
	// Disturbances, when set, makes the server run the disturbance data
	// transfer of clause 7.4.7 itself.
	Disturbances DisturbanceSource

	// QueueSize bounds each of the class 1 and class 2 queues. Zero means
	// [DefaultQueueSize]. Sending to a full queue returns [ErrQueueFull].
	QueueSize int
	// Location is the time zone of the time tags; nil means UTC.
	Location *time.Location
	// SyncTimeout is how long time tags stay valid after the last time
	// synchronization. Zero means [DefaultSyncTimeout].
	SyncTimeout time.Duration
	// SyncDelay is added to a received synchronization time: the
	// transmission time of the ASDU 6, its length in bits times the bit
	// time (clause 7.4.2). Zero means the length of the FT 1.2 frame (21
	// characters of 11 bits) at BitRate; negative means no correction, for
	// a transport that is not a serial line.
	SyncDelay time.Duration
	// BitRate is the line speed in bit/s from which the default SyncDelay
	// is computed. Zero means [DefaultBitRate].
	BitRate int
	// AnswerBroadcastSync makes the server answer a broadcast time
	// synchronization (send/no reply to address 255) with the
	// monitor-direction ASDU 6 too. Off by default: figure 5 of clause
	// 7.4.2 has broadcast messages need no answer; an addressed
	// synchronization is always answered.
	AnswerBroadcastSync bool
	// OnTimeSync is called with each synchronization time the server
	// applies, from the goroutine that calls the Handler, under the same
	// rules as the Handler.
	OnTimeSync func(t time.Time, broadcast bool)

	// OnState is called with each change of the link state: from the
	// station's link goroutine on a reset, and from Close for
	// StateClosed. It must return quickly. It may call Close, which then
	// does not wait for the link goroutine. An OnState that does not
	// return normally is logged and closes the server, as for the Handler.
	OnState func(s iec103.State, err error)
	// Logger receives the log entries; nil is silent.
	Logger iec60870.Logger
}
```

Config configures a server.

### type DisturbanceSource

```go
type DisturbanceSource interface {
	// List returns the recorded disturbances, at most
	// [iec103.MaxDisturbances], for ASDU 23.
	List() []iec103.RecordedFault
	// Record returns the record of fault number fan.
	Record(fan uint16) (*iec103.Disturbance, bool)
	// Transmitted is called with the final acknowledgement of a transfer
	// (ASDU 25, TOO 64 or 65). Clause 7.4.7: the record may be deleted
	// only after a positive acknowledgement.
	Transmitted(fan uint16, ok bool)
}
```

DisturbanceSource supplies the recorded disturbances for the transfer of clause 7.4.7. Calls come from the server's handler goroutine, under the rules of the [Handler](#type-handler): a method that does not return normally closes the server.

### type Handler

```go
type Handler interface {
	HandleASDU(s *Server, a *iec103.ASDU)
}
```

Handler handles the control-direction ASDUs of the controlling system that the server does not handle itself: general interrogation (ASDU 7), general commands (ASDU 20), generic services (ASDUs 10 and 21), the disturbance orders (ASDUs 24 and 25) when no [DisturbanceSource](#type-disturbancesource) is configured, and any private ASDU. Calls are made one at a time from a goroutine of the server; the handler answers through the Server, whose methods it may call. Close from the handler does not wait for the handler's goroutine: it returns at once, and the close completes when the handler has returned. A handler that does not return normally is logged with its stack and closes the server; [Server.Err](#func-server-err) reports it.

The ASDU is the handler's own: a new one is decoded for each call and the server keeps no reference to it, so the handler may keep or modify it.

#### func (Server) AckCommand

```go
func (s *Server) AckCommand(req *iec103.ASDU, positive bool) error
```

AckCommand acknowledges the general command req (clause 7.4.4): ASDU 1 with the FUN and INF of the command, cause 20 (positive) or 21 (negative), the DCO as DPI and the RII as SIN. A positive command is followed by the change of state with cause 12, which the application sends ([Server.Event](#func-server-event)). A req whose body is not a general command ([iec103.GeneralCommand](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#GeneralCommand)), such as an ASDU 20 with a private cause that decodes as [iec103.Raw](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#Raw), returns an error wrapping [iec103.ErrInvalid](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#ErrInvalid) and acknowledges nothing.

#### func (Server) AnswerGI

```go
func (s *Server) AnswerGI(req *iec103.ASDU, data ...*iec103.ASDU) error
```

AnswerGI answers the general interrogation req (ASDU 7, clause 7.4.3): it queues data with cause 9, the scan number as SIN of time-tagged messages, then the termination (ASDU 8) with the scan number. With a [DisturbanceSource](#type-disturbancesource) the list of recorded disturbances follows (ASDU 23, cause 31, with the function type of the equipment, clauses 7.3.1.11 and 7.4.7). A new ASDU 7 that arrives before the cycle was polled drops what is left of it, termination included (clause 7.4.3). A req whose body is not a general interrogation ([iec103.GIInit](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#GIInit)), such as an ASDU 7 with a private cause that decodes as [iec103.Raw](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#Raw), returns an error wrapping [iec103.ErrInvalid](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#ErrInvalid) and queues nothing.

#### func (Server) AnswerGenericGI

```go
func (s *Server) AnswerGenericGI(req *iec103.ASDU, sets ...iec103.DataSet) error
```

AnswerGenericGI answers the general interrogation of generic data req (ASDU 21, INF 245, clause 7.4.8.7): ASDU 10 with INF 244 and cause 9 carrying the data sets, then the end (INF 245, cause 10, NGD 0). A new general interrogation of generic data that arrives before the cycle was polled drops what is left of it, end included (clause 7.4.8.7).

#### func (Server) Close

```go
func (s *Server) Close() error
```

Close stops the station. Close is safe to call more than once and from several goroutines: the first call closes the transport and returns its error; later calls return nil.

Called from the Handler, OnTimeSync, the [DisturbanceSource](#type-disturbancesource) or OnState, Close cannot wait for the goroutine it runs on: it stops the server and returns nil at once, and the close completes, StateClosed reported included, when that callback has returned.

#### func (Server) Done

```go
func (s *Server) Done() <-chan struct{}
```

Done is closed when the station stops: after Close, a transport failure, or a callback that did not return normally. Err tells which.

#### func (Server) Err

```go
func (s *Server) Err() error
```

Err returns the error that stopped the station: the transport's, or that of a callback that did not return normally (wrapping [iec103.ErrClosed](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103#ErrClosed)); nil while it runs or after Close.

#### func (Server) GenericAnswer

```go
func (s *Server) GenericAnswer(req *iec103.ASDU, cause iec103.Cause, sets ...iec103.DataSet) error
```

GenericAnswer answers the generic command req (ASDU 21 or 10) with ASDU 10: the RII and INF of req, the given cause (42 or 43 for reads, 40, 41 or 44 for writes, 9 for the general interrogation of generic data) and the data sets, split over several ASDUs when they need it.

#### func (Server) GenericIdentAnswer

```go
func (s *Server) GenericIdentAnswer(req *iec103.ASDU, cause iec103.Cause, gin iec103.GIN, elems ...iec103.DescElement) error
```

GenericIdentAnswer answers a read of the directory of a single entry (INF 243) with ASDU 11.

#### func (Server) Now

```go
func (s *Server) Now() cp.Timestamp
```

Now returns the station's time as a time tag: the local clock corrected by the last synchronization, with IV set before the first one and when the last is older than [Config.SyncTimeout](#func-config-synctimeout) (clause 7.4.2).
